summary: The PR addresses the issue of PythonCodePrinter not supporting Indexed by adding a specific method. The tests pass, but there are minor style and documentation issues.

issues.description: The added method uses str(base) instead of self._print(base) which might not handle all cases correctly. It should use self._print(base) to ensure consistent printing.
The new method _print_Indexed lacks a docstring explaining its purpose and usage.
